    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\Cargo.toml",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 295
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 344
          }

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "unnecessary_to_owned = \"deny\"",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "unwrap_used = \"deny\"",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "# cargo-shear cannot see the platform-specific openssl-sys usage, so we",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "text": "# silence the false positive here instead of deleting a real dependency.",
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "[workspace.metadata.cargo-shear]",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "text": "ignored = [\"icu_provider\", \"openssl-sys\", \"codex-utils-readiness\"]",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "[profile.dev]",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "# Enable incremental compilation for faster rebuilds",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "text": "incremental = true",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "# Use more codegen units for faster compilation (trade-off: less optimization)",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "codegen-units = 16",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "# Keep debug info for better error messages",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "debug = true",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "[profile.release]",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "lto = \"fat\"",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "# Because we bundle some of these executables with the TypeScript CLI, we",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "# remove everything to make the binary as small as possible.",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "strip = \"symbols\"",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "# See https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/1411 for details.",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "codegen-units = 1",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "[profile.ci-test]",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "debug = 1         # Reduce debug symbol size",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "inherits = \"test\"",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "opt-level = 0",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "[profile.ci-release]",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "inherits = \"release\"",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
